test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Each and every individual has the ________ to follow her/his own religion.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Freedom**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about the right of an individual to choose their own religion.
 
• '**Freedom**' is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank, as it signifies the right to make a choice without any compulsion or restriction.
 
• Grammatically, '**freedom**' is a noun and fits well in the sentence structure.
 
• Other options like 'compulsion', 'economy', and 'expulsion' do not convey the intended meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence**: *Each and every individual has the freedom __to follow her/his own religion.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Compulsion **means forcing someone to do something.
 
• **Economy **refers to the system of production, distribution, and consumption of goods and services.
 
• **Expulsion **means removing someone from a place or organization.
